topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The package arrived on a Monday, unseasonably heavy with the weight of things unsaid. I didn’t recognize the handwriting at first, the loops and tails unfamiliar, like a message from a stranger. Inside, a collection of old photographs, yellowed at the edges, captured moments that seemed both distant and intimately near. There was a note, too, tucked under the photographs, the paper thin and the words penned with a care that spoke of the hours spent over it. It thanked me for the years, for the stories and the lessons, the times in and out of the classroom. I traced the lines of the handwriting, thinking about the years that have passed, the places those students must be now, and the part of my life that remains here, in this quiet, shadowed room.
